claim: IZB 2026 official site — dates, venue at Allerpark Wolfsburg, expected 40,000 trade visitors, focus areas including new Cross Industry Area.
quote: 40,000 Trade Visitors expected. The IZB is an important communication and business platform for the industry.

claim: Confirmed new IZB 2026 dates: 27–29 October 2026 in Wolfsburg, after postponement from the originally planned slot.
quote: UPDATE: IZB 2026 postponed - New dates: 27 to 29 October 2026

claim: Circularity Days 2026 runs 20–21 May 2026 at the MobileLifeCampus, co-organised by Fraunhofer CCEM, focus on circular and sustainable production.
quote: The Circularity Days 2026 Conference will take place on May 20 and 21, 2026, at the MobileLifeCampus (MLC) in Wolfsburg.

claim: Circularity Days connects science and industry; descends from Werkstoffsymposium and FAPC; based at OHLF (TU Braunschweig + Fraunhofer + industry partners); evening event at ZeitHaus Autostadt; Salzgitter AG steel-mill excursion.
quote: The conference emphasizes Connecting Science & Industry with emphasis on sustainable manufacturing. The event builds on two predecessor conferences (Werkstoffsymposium and Future Automotive Production Conference).

claim: WE & AI Campus is a Volkswagen Group IT + Autostadt joint AI congress held 21–22 November 2024 at Autostadt's Panoramakino, with VW Design / Group Innovation / Elli sessions.
quote: WE & AI Campus: KI-Kongress am 21. und 22. November in der Autostadt. Gemeinsamer Termin von Konzern-IT und Autostadt.

claim: FutureCongress.digital is ASTRID iHUB's flagship event; editions held in 2022, 2023 and 2024 (the 2024 edition was 14–15 Nov at Autostadt); covers Smart City / Mobility / Industry / Security.
quote: FutureCongress.digital 2024. Date: November 14-15. Venue: Autostadt.

claim: FutureCongress.digital is organised by Stadtwerke Wolfsburg AG + WOBCOM as part of the ASTRID Innovation Hub; aimed at decision-makers from administration, politics, business and digitalization.
quote: A central event around digital transformation of cities, communities and industries.

claim: OHLF's Werkstoffsymposium and Future Automotive Production Conference (FAPC) were merged into a single Wolfsburg event at the Mobile Life Campus.
quote: Die normalerweise jährlich abwechselnd stattfindenden Veranstaltungen Werkstoffsymposium und Future Automotive Production Conference (FAPC) fanden gemeinsam am Mobile Life Campus statt.

claim: CIOmove@Volkswagen took place 6–7 March 2024 in Wolfsburg; Dr. Sven Lorenz (Head of Group Data & AI) presented Data and AI in Industrial Applications.
quote: CIOmove@Volkswagen on March 6 & 7, 2024. Dr. Sven Lorenz, Head of Group Data & AI at Volkswagen Group, spoke about Data and AI in Industrial Applications.

claim: phaeno hosts a monthly Science Talk one Thursday at 18:30, free, hybrid (in-person + YouTube); 2026 line-up incl. 3D-printing/robotics (28 May), microfluidics (25 Jun), zoonosis (30 Jul), medical diagnostics (27 Aug), AI lecture series Sep–Oct.
quote: One Thursday evening a month at 6.30 pm, the phaeno Science Theatre hosts a high-profile event exploring topics in science and technology. Admission is free.

claim: WolfsburgDigital is a joint initiative of the City of Wolfsburg and Volkswagen AG (since 2016) running trade shows, conferences and regular meetups (Stammtische) on digital topics.
quote: Mit unseren Partnern entwickeln wir gemeinsam eine Digitalisierungsstrategie für den Standort Wolfsburg.

claim: 42 Wolfsburg is a free, peer-learning coding school funded by Volkswagen Group; the Learning Spaceship is open 24/7.
quote: 42 Wolfsburg | Free Coding School. The Learning Spaceship is open 24/7.

claim: 42 Wolfsburg holds Open Days at least once per quarter; Piscine immersion sessions in 2026 are 6–31 July and 21 September – 16 October.
quote: Open Days at least once per quarter. The upcoming Piscine sessions are scheduled for July 6th – July 31st, 2026 and September 21st – October 16th, 2026.

claim: Meetup.com lists the Wolfsburg-area tech community: 42 Wolfsburg Coding School (616 members), WOB Online Developer & Clean Code (23), PMI BS-WOB local group, eXXchange IT Braunschweig (103), and an Artificial Intelligence Meetup Wolfsburg.
quote: 42 Wolfsburg Coding School - 616 members. WOB Online | Developer & Clean Code - Community of Practice - 23 members.

claim: CongressPark Wolfsburg is the city's main convention venue: three congress halls, ten conference rooms, Great Hall up to 2,044 people, near the pedestrian zone.
quote: Drei Kongresssäle und zehn Konferenzräume. Der große Saal fasst bis zu 2.044 Personen.

claim: MobileLifeCampus is a Volkswagen-built conference and innovation campus at the south edge of the Autostadt site, with a four-storey glazed atrium and grouped seminar rooms.
quote: Der MobileLifeCampus ist ein Tagungs- und Konferenzzentrum der Volkswagen AG in Wolfsburg.

claim: The Joint Campus Wolfsburg (TU Braunschweig + Fraunhofer + Ostfalia + OHLF) was rebranded WeCampusWOB on 11 May 2026, focused on circular automotive research, teaching and transfer.
quote: The Joint Campus Wolfsburg is now known as WeCampusWOB. The name announcement took place on May 11, 2026 in Wolfsburg.

claim: Schiller40 is the City of Wolfsburg's municipal coworking space in the Markthalle on Porschestraße, 30 workstations, AR/VR + podcast studio + seminar rooms.
quote: Schiller40 is the coworking space of Wolfsburg, located in the centrally-positioned Markthalle in Wolfsburg's city center. 30 workstations for mobile work.

claim: Schiller40 opened in 2012 as Germany's first municipal coworking space; hosts events including Volkswagen corporate assemblies and the Mobility Startup Day Lower Saxony.
quote: SCHILLER40 ist Deutschlands erster kommunaler Coworking Space (seit 2012). Hat Veranstaltungen wie Volkswagen Vollversammlungen und den Mobility Startup Day Niedersachsen gestreamt.

claim: Volkswagen Group's International Security Management Conference (ISMC) is held at the MobileLifeCampus; the 2025 edition convened security leaders from all brands, companies and plants.
quote: Security leaders from all brands, companies and plants met to discuss current and future security challenges for the Volkswagen Group.

claim: phaeno is a Zaha Hadid–designed science centre in Wolfsburg with 300+ exhibits; updated for 2026 for its 20th anniversary; rentable for events up to ~800 people.
quote: phaeno is a Science Centre located in a spectacular architectural sculpture by star architect Zaha Hadid, with over 300 phenomena.
